raw:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate) AS Month,
    SUM(Revenue) AS MonthlyTotal,
    LAG(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)) AS PreviousMonthTotal,
    (SUM(Revenue) - LAG(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate))) / NULLIF(LAG(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)), 0) * 100 AS ChangeFromPreviousMonth
FROM Ecommerce
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OrderDate) = 2024
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)
ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate);

raw:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate) AS Month, 
       SUM(Revenue) AS TotalRevenue, 
       LAG(SUM(Revenue), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)) AS PrevMonthTotalRevenue,
       SUM(Revenue) - LAG(SUM(Revenue), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)) AS RevenueDiff
FROM Ecommerce
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OrderDate) = 2024
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)
ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate);
sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate) AS Month, 
       SUM(Revenue) AS TotalRevenue, 
       LAG(SUM(Revenue), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)) AS PrevMonthTotalRevenue,
       SUM(Revenue) - LAG(SUM(Revenue), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)) AS RevenueDiff

```sql
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate) AS Month,
    SUM(FinalPrice) AS TotalRevenue,
    LAG(SUM(FinalPrice)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)) - SUM(FinalPrice) AS RevenueChange
FROM 
    Ecommerce
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OrderDate) = 2024
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)
ORDER BY 
    Month;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    e1.OrderID,
    e2.OrderDate - e1.OrderDate AS DaysBetweenOrders
FROM 
    Ecommerce e1
JOIN 
    Ecommerce e2
ON 
    e1.CustomerID = e2.CustomerID AND e1.OrderID < e2.OrderID
WHERE 
    (e1.CustomerID, e1.OrderID) IN (
        SELECT 
            CustomerID, MIN(OrderID)
        FROM 
            Ecommerce
        GROUP BY 
            CustomerID
    )
ORDER BY 
    e1.OrderID;
```

```sql
WITH BirthDecade AS (
    SELECT 
        PresidentName,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM YearBorn) / 10 * 10 AS Decade
    FROM 
        President
)
SELECT 
    Decade, 
    COUNT(*) AS NumberOfPresidents
FROM 
    BirthDecade
GROUP BY 
    Decade
ORDER BY 
    Decade;
```

```sql
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY CustomerID
            ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Ecommerce
),
counts AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM Ecommerce
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT
    r1.CustomerID,
    r1.OrderDate AS FirstOrderDate,
    r2.OrderDate AS SecondOrderDate,
    (r2.OrderDate - r1.OrderDate) AS DaysBetween
FROM ranked r1
JOIN ranked r2
    ON r1.CustomerID = r2.CustomerID
    AND r1.rn = 1
    AND r2.rn = 2
JOIN counts c
    ON c.CustomerID = r1.CustomerID;
```

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate) AS month_date,
        SUM(Revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM Ecommerce
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate)
),
revenue_with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        month_date,
        total_revenue,
        total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_date) AS revenue_change
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(month_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    total_revenue,
    revenue_change
FROM revenue_with_lag
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_date) = 2024
ORDER BY month_date;

WITH DistinctOrders AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
    FROM Ecommerce
    GROUP BY CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
),
RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
    FROM DistinctOrders
)
SELECT
    r1.CustomerID,
    r2.OrderDate - r1.OrderDate AS days_between
FROM RankedOrders r1
JOIN RankedOrders r2 ON r1.CustomerID = r2.CustomerID AND r1.rn = 1 AND r2.rn = 2

WITH DistinctOrders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
    FROM Ecommerce
),
RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn
    FROM DistinctOrders
)
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN OrderDate END) AS days_between
FROM RankedOrders
WHERE rn <= 2
GROUP BY CustomerID
HAVING COUNT(*) = 2;
sql:
WITH DistinctOrders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
    FROM Ecommerce
),
RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn
    FROM DistinctOrders
)
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN OrderDate END) AS days_between
FROM RankedOrders
WHERE rn <= 2
GROUP BY CustomerID
HAVING COUNT(*) = 2

SELECT CustomerID,
       first_order_date,
       second_order_date,
       second_order_date - first_order_date AS days_between_first_two_orders
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           OrderDate AS first_order_date,
           LEAD(OrderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS second_order_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID) AS order_count
    FROM Ecommerce
) t
WHERE rn = 1
  AND order_count >= 2;

SELECT
  CustomerID,
  first_order_date,
  second_order_date,
  second_order_date - first_order_date AS days_between_first_two_orders
FROM (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    OrderDate AS first_order_date,
    LEAD(OrderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS second_order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID) AS order_count
  FROM Ecommerce
) t
WHERE rn = 1
  AND order_count >= 2;

WITH president_decades AS (
    SELECT
        (YearBorn / 10) * 10 AS decade,
        PresidentName
    FROM President
    WHERE YearBorn IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    decade,
    COUNT(*) AS president_count
FROM president_decades
GROUP BY decade
ORDER BY decade;

SELECT
  OrderDate,
  SUM(Revenue) AS DailyRevenue,
  AVG(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (
    ORDER BY OrderDate
    ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS MovingAvg7DayRevenue
FROM Ecommerce
GROUP BY OrderDate
ORDER BY OrderDate;
